note: The Credit Bureau Regulations (Government Notice 103 of 2014, surviving under the Bank of Namibia Act 1 of 2020), regulation 31: a data subject's payment profile is retained five years from the event; read in the Legal Assistance Centre's annotated statutes, registered as secondary. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update. Re-read 2026-11-03: the gazette itself (No. 5518 of 31 July 2014, as the Bank of Namibia publishes it) states regulation 31's five years for the payment profile. The gazette made the regulations under the 1997 Act and doesn't itself say they survive under the 2020 Act; the Bank of Namibia lists them under the 2020 Act's page. The fact is found on the gazette and the Legal Assistance Centre's copy is no longer cited.
